description:
What other arXiv papers do with this paper, and what it does with the
    arXiv papers it cites: builds on, uses the method or tool, uses the data,
    compares with, cites as support or background, or contests. Each group
    counts distinct papers and quotes the citing authors' own sentences.
    Labels come from each citing paper's LaTeX source typed by Pith's classifier and are
    shown only at intent probability 0.8 or more (support at 0.95, contests at 0.7);
    the rest are counted as unlabelled. Measured agreement of every label with
    independent model families: https://pith.science/connected-record. Use this
    for how a result has been taken up, challenged or built on across arXiv.
